archiveDescription.en: Every verified lab update remains available in chronological order.
archiveDescription.zh: 所有已核验的实验室动态均按时间顺序完整保留。

title.zh: 最新发布

description.en: Research, open-source releases, datasets, and real-world deployments from AMAP CV Lab.
description.zh: 高德视觉技术中心的研究、开源发布、数据集与真实世界落地动态。

title.zh: ABot-World Explorer 500 小时数据集发布

summary.en: The 500-hour video training dataset with action annotations is now available on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
summary.zh: 带动作标注的 500 小时视频训练数据现已在 Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 发布。

alt.en: Samples from the ABot-World Explorer training dataset
alt.zh: ABot-World Explorer 训练数据样例

title.zh: ABot-World-0 技术报告发布

summary.en: The report details real-time, open-ended, action-conditioned world rollout on a single desktop GPU.
summary.zh: 报告系统阐述了在单张桌面级 GPU 上实现实时、开放式、动作条件世界推演的方法。

title.en: ABot-M0.5 inference, weights, and evaluation released
title.zh: ABot-M0.5 推理代码、权重与评测发布

summary.en: The public release includes inference code, pretrained weights, and evaluation scripts for LIBERO and RoboCasa365.
summary.zh: 本次公开发布包含推理代码、预训练权重，以及面向 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa365 的评测脚本。

title.zh: ABot-AgentOS 项目页上线

summary.en: The project page presents the Agent OS architecture, lifelong multimodal memory, and embodied execution framework; code remains in preparation.
summary.zh: 项目页展示了 Agent OS 架构、终身多模态记忆与具身执行框架；代码仍在准备中。

title.zh: ABot-3DWorld 发布

summary.en: ABot-3DWorld unifies text, image, and video inputs into explorable 3D worlds connected to real geographic places.
summary.zh: ABot-3DWorld 将文本、图像与视频统一转化为连接真实地理地点的可探索三维世界。

title.en: ABot-N1 technical report and benchmark suite released
title.zh: ABot-N1 技术报告与基准套件发布

summary.en: The report presents a general visual-language navigation foundation model; benchmark data and evaluation tools are public, while model weights are not presented as released.
summary.zh: 报告提出通用视觉语言导航基础模型；基准数据与评测工具已公开，但不将模型权重表述为已发布。

title.zh: ABot-AgentOS 技术报告发布

summary.en: ABot-AgentOS introduces a general robotic Agent OS with a reasoning-execution-verification loop and lifelong multimodal memory.
summary.zh: ABot-AgentOS 提出具备推理—执行—验证闭环与终身多模态记忆的通用机器人 Agent OS。

title.en: ABot-World-0 causal model, inference, Gradio, and Studio released
title.zh: ABot-World-0 因果模型、推理、Gradio 与 Studio 发布

summary.en: The first public ABot-World release includes the 5B causal student model, inference code, an easy-to-run local Gradio demo, and the online ABot World Studio.
summary.zh: ABot-World 首次公开发布包含 5B 因果学生模型、推理代码、易于运行的本地 Gradio 演示与在线 ABot World Studio。

title.zh: ABot-M0.5 技术报告发布

summary.en: The report introduces a unified mobility-and-manipulation World Action Model built around three levels of alignment.
summary.zh: 报告提出以三层对齐为核心的统一移动与操作世界动作模型。

title.zh: ABot-Earth-0.5 发布

summary.en: The generative 3D Earth model launches with a technical report and interactive site; no code or model release is claimed.
summary.zh: 生成式三维地球模型发布技术报告与交互网站；不宣称代码或模型权重已经发布。

news.editorialNote: The arXiv publication record is used as the date source. The July 29, 2025 line in the repository README is inconsistent and is not used.

title.en: ABot-OCR report, weights, and inference released
title.zh: ABot-OCR 报告、权重与推理发布

summary.en: ABot-OCR converts document page images directly into structured Markdown while preserving text, formulas, tables, and layout.
summary.zh: ABot-OCR 将文档页面图像直接转化为结构化 Markdown，并保留文本、公式、表格与版式。

title.zh: ABot-Explorer 技术报告发布

summary.en: ABot-Explorer studies human-like autonomous exploration with vision-language models across 3DGS and Habitat environments.
summary.zh: ABot-Explorer 研究视觉语言模型在 3DGS 与 Habitat 环境中的类人自主探索。

title.en: AMAP debuts Tutu, its first quadruped embodied robot
title.zh: 高德首款四足具身机器人“途途”公开亮相

summary.en: Tutu appeared at the 2026 Beijing E-Town Humanoid Robot Half-Marathon, demonstrating AMAP's physical-AI path from navigation research to real-world guidance.
summary.zh: “途途”亮相 2026 北京亦庄人形机器人半程马拉松，展示高德从导航研究走向真实引导服务的 Physical AI 路径。

label.zh: 阿里巴巴集团官网报道

alt.en: AMAP quadruped robot Tutu at a public demonstration
alt.zh: 高德四足机器人“途途”公开演示

title.zh: ABot-PhysWorld 扩展开源技术栈

summary.en: April releases added action-to-video training and inference, physics-aware DPO, and public benchmark results to the existing inference, SFT, data, and EZS-Bench resources.
summary.zh: 4 月发布新增动作到视频训练与推理、物理感知 DPO 和公开基准结果，并延续此前的推理、SFT、数据与 EZS-Bench 资源。

title.zh: ABot-PhysWorld 技术报告发布

summary.en: The report introduces a physics-aligned, action-controllable video world model for robotic manipulation.
summary.zh: 报告提出面向机器人操作、经过物理对齐且可由动作控制的视频世界模型。

title.en: AMAP launches AI-powered Flying Street View
title.zh: 高德发布 AI 驱动的“飞行街景”

summary.en: Built on AMAP's world-model technology, Flying Street View creates continuous 3D-like tours from streets into local businesses and is being opened to one million merchants.
summary.zh: “飞行街景”基于高德自研世界模型，从街道连续进入门店，生成沉浸式实景体验，并向 100 万商家开放。

label.zh: 阿里巴巴集团官网报道

title.en: Seven AMAP CV Lab papers accepted to ICLR 2026
title.zh: 高德视觉技术中心七篇论文获 ICLR 2026 录用

summary.en: The accepted work spans online navigation refinement, embodied navigation, world modeling, and 3D generation, including JanusVLN, CE-Nav, OmniNav, FantasyWorld, Sat3DGen, and CLoD-GS.
summary.zh: 录用工作覆盖在线导航优化、具身导航、世界建模与三维生成，包括 JanusVLN、CE-Nav、OmniNav、FantasyWorld、Sat3DGen 与 CLoD-GS。

evidence.source: AMAP CV Lab official homepage announcement

title.en: FantasyVLN training, inference, and model released
title.zh: FantasyVLN 训练、推理代码与模型权重开源

summary.en: The official FantasyVLN repository and model checkpoints are now public.
summary.zh: FantasyVLN 的训练与推理代码及模型权重已正式公开。

title.zh: FantasyWorld 登顶 WorldScore 评测

summary.en: FantasyWorld reached the top position on the public WorldScore leaderboard.
summary.zh: FantasyWorld 在公开 WorldScore 评测中位列第一。

title.zh: 五篇论文获 AAAI 2026 录用

summary.en: UniMapGen was selected for an oral presentation alongside PriorDrive, PAMR, FantasyTalking2, and FantasyHSI.
summary.zh: UniMapGen 获 Oral；PriorDrive、PAMR、FantasyTalking2 与 FantasyHSI 同期录用。

title.en: FutureSightDrive selected as a NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight
title.zh: FutureSightDrive 入选 NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight

summary.en: The autonomous-driving work was accepted to NeurIPS 2025 as a Spotlight paper.
summary.zh: 该自动驾驶研究获 NeurIPS 2025 录用并入选 Spotlight。

title.zh: FantasyTalking 获 ACM MM 2025 录用

summary.en: FantasyTalking’s coherent-motion approach was accepted to ACM Multimedia 2025.
summary.zh: FantasyTalking 的连贯运动生成研究获 ACM Multimedia 2025 录用。

title.zh: SeqGrowGraph 获 ICCV 2025 录用

summary.en: The lane-topology work was accepted to ICCV 2025.
summary.zh: 该车道拓扑研究获 ICCV 2025 录用。

title.zh: FutureSightDrive 完整项目发布

summary.en: The complete FutureSightDrive project page and resources became public.
summary.zh: FutureSightDrive 完整项目页面与资源正式发布。

title.zh: G3PT 获 IJCAI 2025 录用

summary.en: The autoregressive 3D generation work was accepted to IJCAI 2025.
summary.zh: 该自回归三维生成研究获 IJCAI 2025 录用。

title.en: FantasyTalking and FantasyID code and weights released
title.zh: FantasyTalking 与 FantasyID 代码及权重发布

summary.en: Inference code and model weights for both projects became public.
summary.zh: 两个项目的推理代码与模型权重正式公开。

title.en: FantasyWorld code and model weights released
title.zh: FantasyWorld 代码与模型权重发布

summary.en: The official repository released inference code and model checkpoints.
summary.zh: 官方仓库发布推理代码与模型权重。

title.en: ABot-N0 and ABot-M0 technical reports released
title.zh: ABot-N0 与 ABot-M0 技术报告发布

summary.en: The navigation and manipulation foundation-model reports were published as separate works.
summary.zh: 导航与操作基础模型分别发布独立技术报告。

title.zh: AstraNav-World 研究发布

summary.en: The navigation world model for foresight control and consistency was published.
summary.zh: 面向前瞻控制与一致性的导航世界模型正式发布。

title.en: AstraNav-Memory, SocialNav, and FantasyVLN appear at CVPR 2026
title.zh: AstraNav-Memory、SocialNav 与 FantasyVLN 亮相 CVPR 2026

summary.en: The three navigation works joined CVPR 2026, with SocialNav selected as an Oral.
summary.zh: 三项导航研究入选 CVPR 2026，其中 SocialNav 获 Oral。

title.zh: Sat3DGen 研究与代码发布

summary.en: The satellite-to-street-level 3D generation project is publicly available.
summary.zh: 从卫星图像生成街景级三维场景的项目已公开。

title.en: Reasoning Over Space published at ACL 2026
title.zh: Reasoning Over Space 发表于 ACL 2026

summary.en: The geographic-reasoning work appears as an ACL 2026 Long Paper.
summary.zh: 该地理空间推理研究以 ACL 2026 Long Paper 发表。
